overview.title: Lakeview FFL at a glance
overview.description: How the league is organized, what defines the current season, and where to find its records.

paragraphs: 2026 is the active Lakeview season, played on Sleeper as a 12-team redraft league.
Lakeview has continuous league history since 2019. Game-by-game records begin with the 2022 Sleeper season.
Every completed season from 2019 through 2025 is archived, with champions and franchise history kept.

story.title: Our Story: Lakeview
story.teaser: Lakeview FFL started in 2019 at a backyard cookout, when twelve neighbors decided a group chat full of trash talk needed a scoreboard.
